description: Live service status (current train information) for a Japanese railway line: normal operation, delays, or suspension, with the operator's own status text in Japanese and English and when it was last updated. Covers Tokyo Metro, JR East, Toei and other Japan railway operators publishing to ODPT. Needs an ODPT developer consumer key via _apiKey; Pipeworx supplies one if omitted. Example: odpt_service_status({ railway: "Yamanote", operator: "JR East" }).

_apiKey.description: Optional: your own ODPT developer consumer key. Pipeworx supplies one if omitted.

operator.description: Operator, e.g. "Tokyo Metro", "JR East", "Toei", or an exact odpt.Operator id. Required if railway is not an exact id.

railway.description: Railway/line name (e.g. "Yamanote", "Marunouchi") or an exact odpt.Railway id. Optional if operator is given — returns all of that operator's lines.

name: odpt_service_status
